verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents its own cross-border Transfers and Batch Transfers to move funds globally to suppliers, employees, contractors, and own accounts. Nothing in the pack says how fast these transfers arrive, so the under-a-minute part of the story is unsupported. missing for 10: any documented delivery-speed or settlement-time claim (instant or under-a-minute arrival), corridor and rail details for real-time payouts, independent or hands-on corroboration of transfer speed

support.subject: As a founder, I can send money abroad that arrives in under a minute

citations.quote: Airwallex Transfers allows you to move funds across the globe easily to your suppliers, employees, contractors and/or own bank accounts.
Easily manage multiple transfers to recipients in various countries/regions and in various currencies to multiple beneficiaries for payroll runs and supplier payments.
